title: Automated File Organizer & CLI Utility
description: Build a command-line utility in Python that scans directories, classifies files by extension and metadata, and automates file organization with error logging and Git tracking.
expected_outcomes: Modular Python script utilizing os, shutil, and argparse
Robust file parsing, exception handling, and automated unit tests
Git commit history with semantic commit messages

title: REST API Web Scraper & Data Extractor
description: Construct a Python application that fetches public web data, handles pagination and rate-limits, and persists structured JSON records.
expected_outcomes: Working Python scraper with requests / httpx and BeautifulSoup
Structured JSON export pipeline with data validation

title: Exploratory Data Analysis & Visual Dashboard
description: Clean, manipulate, and explore real-world tabular data using Pandas and NumPy, producing visual correlation matrices, trend charts, and summary reports.
expected_outcomes: Jupyter analysis notebook cleaning missing values and outliers
Data distribution plots and multi-variable hypothesis testing

title: Customer Churn Prediction & Model Evaluation
description: Train, tune, and evaluate classical machine learning models (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost) to predict customer churn with precision-recall curve analysis.
expected_outcomes: Scikit-learn pipeline featuring feature encoding and standard scaling
Comprehensive evaluation report with ROC-AUC, F1-score, and confusion matrix

title: Production ML Inference REST API
description: Package a trained ML model into an asynchronous FastAPI REST service with Pydantic request validation, batch scoring, health check endpoints, and a Docker container.
expected_outcomes: FastAPI endpoint with OpenAPI documentation and input validation
Docker container image ready for cloud deployment

title: Deep Neural Network Image & Sentiment Classifier
description: Design and train deep multi-layer neural networks for image or text classification with PyTorch, monitoring training loss, validation accuracy, and early stopping.
expected_outcomes: PyTorch training script with DataLoader and custom neural architecture
TensorBoard / Matplotlib training curve visualizations

title: Fine-Tuned Transformer Document Classifier
description: Fine-tune a pretrained BERT/RoBERTa transformer model using Hugging Face Transformers for domain-specific text classification with LoRA/PEFT adaptation.
expected_outcomes: Fine-tuned transformer checkpoint with evaluated macro F1 score
Hugging Face pipeline deployment for batch inference

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Document Knowledge Assistant
description: Build an enterprise document question-answering assistant that embeds PDF manuals into a Vector Database (Chroma/Pinecone), performs hybrid search, and synthesizes answers using an LLM.
expected_outcomes: Chunking, embedding, and vector storage pipeline
Hallucination mitigation with source citation retrieval
Interactive Streamlit / FastAPI UI

title: Autonomous Multi-Tool AI Research Agent
description: Construct an autonomous AI Agent utilizing ReAct reasoning loops, dynamic tool calling (web search, calculator, SQL query engine), and session memory to solve multi-step research queries.
expected_outcomes: ReAct agent architecture with function calling and error recovery
Integrated SQLite database and search API tools
Dockerized production deployment

title: Secure E-Commerce REST API with Spring Boot
description: Develop a multi-tier Spring Boot backend with Hibernate/JPA, PostgreSQL relational persistence, JWT authentication, and comprehensive unit/integration test suites.
expected_outcomes: Spring Boot REST controller suite with Spring Security & JWT
PostgreSQL database migration scripts and transactional integrity
